scope: Six fixed-version primary arXiv abstracts and metadata inspected; every abstract independently refetched with matching hash. No full-paper review or experimental reproduction.

limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19536: Three tabular task families and author-reported model/API snapshots; dedicated study code was not verified.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.19644: The abstract reports a frozen Qwen backbone and three task families. The linked repository documents saved measurements; no inference or statistical replication was executed.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08155: Primary abstract and selected implementation passages were checked; dedicated code and independent reproduction were not established.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08675: A constructed financial-evidence test, not a population estimate or investment guidance; findings remain author-reported and dedicated code was not verified.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27331: Small complete-system comparisons and limited full games; the abstract explicitly says planning lacks an isolated controlled ablation. A code link is author-provided but not inspected in this pass.
limitations.https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.30186: AndroidWorld evaluation and success-conditioned efficiency summaries; no dedicated implementation or independent reproduction was verified.

deduplication: Compared canonical URLs, abstract hashes and normalized titles against the existing source index and frozen expansion baseline. All six are new.
